name: Switch
purpose: A switch turns one item on or off. The change applies immediately.

anatomy.role: The target: the label, the description, and the track
The control. Its fill shows the state
Moves to the end side for on, to the start side for off
The name: the item that is on
Help text, or the cause when the switch is disabled

moments.when: At the change of the state, not at the end of the knob motion

clauses.text: The accessibility tree shows the control as a switch, with the label as its name and the on or off state.
The label names the item that is on, not an action. Example: Alerts, not Disable alerts.
The change applies immediately. If a change must wait for a Save button, use a checkbox.
When the switch has the focus, Space changes the state. Tab moves the focus to the switch and away from it.
The full row is the target, with the label and the description. In the touch density, the target is 44 px high or more.
The focus ring of the language shows on the track: 2 px in the ring color, 2 px from the track.
On has the accent fill and the knob at the end side. Color is not the only sign of the state.
In a right-to-left layout, the end side is the left side. The knob moves to the left for on.
The knob moves with spring-control. With reduced motion, the knob changes position with no movement, and the change of color stays.
A change emits the moment toggle with the variant on or off, at the change of the state.
The switch starts a haptic or a sound directly.
A disabled switch has the disabled opacity and does not change. Its description tells why the change is not possible.
The track, the knob, and the travel follow the control unit of the density: 16 px for pointer, 20 px for touch.
